entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup init` switching to DotnetupDotnet mode does not remove old shell profile entries #54543
  • `dotnetup install --default` rejects uppercase `SYSTEM` despite documentation #54542
  • dotnet build: Adding -tl:off prevents file-based app detection; breaks with spurious warning and MSBuild error #54540
  • Revisit single-`SignerInfo` restriction in `dotnetup` CMS signature verification (PQC crypto-agility) #54535
  • Revisit certificate pinning in `dotnetup` signature verification with Crypto Board / Threat Model #54534
  • System.Text.Encoding.CodePages giving warning will not be pruned when used with .net version 10 #54530
  • GenAPI: consider a namespace-based heuristic for including internal compiler attributes #54527

Closed

  • Project variables in `launchSettings.json` not subsituted when using `dotnet run` #54538
  • dotnetup can not determine the local application data directory (WSL, Ubuntu 26.04) #54509
  • BCL GetFolderPath APIs may return empty paths, which dotnetup interprets as an error #54493
  • GenAPI omits internally defined types and attributes that are relevant to the langugage / Compiler #33693
    Backlog
  • Trim white spaces in `--test-modules` expression when running `dotnet test` (MTP) CLI command #54158
  • GenAPI omits IndexerNameAttribute #38633
    Backlog
  • Selecting test runner without global.json #51505
  • Improve output of `dotnet test` with MTP #49712
  • Automatically import usings for References #22552
    Discussion
